description: Land Acquisition - Galahitiyawa, Ganemulla, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the compulsory acquisition of multiple land parcels for public purpose (construction of Ganemulla Flyover). It contains detailed descriptions of the specific lots, their extents, claimants, and the purpose of acquisition, which falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) dealing with land acquisitions and property matters.
